description: The pie chart presents the distribution of biomedical named-entity categories (entity types) in the referenced NER context, shown as a single pie divided into 27 slices with percentage labels inside the wedges and category names placed around the perimeter (no separate legend is visible and no slice appears exploded or otherwise emphasized). The largest slice is an unlabeled blue wedge at approximately 32%. Other prominent slices include Protein (orange, ~15%), DNA (green, ~6%), Chemical Family (red, ~5%), Disease (purple, ~5%), Cell Type (brown, ~5%), Drug (pink, ~4%), Frequency (gray, ~3%), Cell Line (yellow, ~3%), Dosage (light blue, ~3%), Strength (dark blue, ~3%), Gene Or Gene Product (orange, ~2%), Form (green, ~2%), Disease Or Phenotypic Feature (red, ~2%), Specific Disease (purple, ~2%), Reason (brown, ~2%), Route (pink, ~2%), Chemical Entity (gray, ~1%), Sequence Variant (yellow, ~1%), Modifier (light blue, ~1%), and several very small slices at ~0% each labeled Disease Class, DNA, Organism Taxon, Duration, and Composite Mention; the slices appear arranged roughly from larger segments on the left/top toward many smaller segments clustered on the right side.
